message.content: {"caption":"Line chart comparing average reward over training steps for All Returns and Answer-Only strategies.","description":"The horizontal axis is Training Step, from 0 to 100 with ticks every 20; the vertical axis is Average Reward, from 0.0 to 1.0 with ticks every 0.2.
